phenotype_evidence: Loss-of-function (LoF) and deleterious missense variants strongly predispose to T2D with OR = 5.91 (95% CI: 3.86-9.04, P = 2.0e-16; UK Biobank 450k WES; Zhao et al., Nature 2021, PMID: 34163065). Wild-type GIGYF1 acts as an endogenous metabolic shield against T2D.

clinical_variants.clinical_impact: Completely abolishes the entire GYF domain, destroying GRB10/14 binding and leading to ~6-fold increase in T2D risk.
Substitutes essential aromatic stacking residue Trp494 with basic Arg, severely disrupting hydrophobic polyproline (PPII) recognition.
Ablates key tyrosine phenolic hydroxyl / aromatic face that packs against GRB10 proline residues.
Reduces structural stability of the central α-helix in the GYF fold.
Introduces bulky positive charge into the flexible turn region, altering entrance accessibility.
